BR-53
BRAKE -- ABSACTUA+OR
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE BATTERY
Remove the hold-down clamp, battery and battery tray.
2. REMOVE MASTER CYLINDER (See page BR-10)
3. REMOVE ECM ANO ECM BRACKET
{a) Remove the 3 bolts, and move the ECM aside.
(b) Disconnect the harness clamp, and remove the bolt, 2
nuts and ECM bracket.
Torque: 19 N-m (195 kgf.cm, 14 ft-lbf)
4. DISCONNECT 2 CONNECTORS
N
5. DISCONNECT BRAKE LINES
Using SST, disconnect the 6 brake lines.
SST 09023---00100
Torque: 15 N-m (155 kgf-cm, 11 ft-lbf)
6. REMOVE ABS ACTUATOR
{a) Disconnect the hose clamp from the actuator bracket un­
der side.
(b) Remove the bolt, nut and ABS actuator assembly.
Torque: 19 N-m (195 kgf.cm, 14 ft-lbf)
(c) Remove the 2 nuts and ABS actuator from the actuator
bracket.
Torque: 5.4 N-m (55 kgf-cm, 48 ln.-lbf)
N (d) Remove the 2 holders and 3 cushions from the ABS ac­
tuator.
